**Summary:**
Customer inquired about Leafy Plus membership ($59/year, auto-renewing). Benefits: free standard shipping, free returns on non-living items, 90-day plant guarantee, 10% accessory/pot discount, early rare plant access. No free express shipping. 14-day refund window if benefits unused. Clarified: 90-day guarantee applies only to plants ordered while membership active; pre-membership plants retain 30-day guarantee from delivery. Plant Care Specialists available for free advice.
